correctness.rationale: The classical Lucas digit factorization yields \(w=(1,-1,-1,0,-1,-1,1)\). The independently reconstructed seven two-by-two addition-carry matrices give exactly \(a_h6^{r-k}-b_h\) on noncyclic blocks, including the final carry. Their induced row infinity norms and strictness of nonzero and six digits prove \(|a_h|\le2\cdot6^{k-1}\) and that equality can occur only at shifts \(3\cdot7^j\) or \(5\cdot7^j\), with respective positive and negative signs. The standalone checker reports 17,262 exact arithmetic assertions; numerical testing supplements rather than replaces the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The Legendre sign of a classical integer sequence has a sparse nonzero support and both signs, making ordinary-density covariance degenerate. The exact all-shift finite-block identity supplies a computable arithmetic invariant, while the sharp interval and complete two resonance families determine meaningful additive structure not settled by a bare digitwise congruence or a finite enumeration.
